desc: Implement LCM calculation for all non-empty subsets of target (at most 15 subsets)
For each number in nums and each subset mask, calculate the increment cost to make nums[i] divisible by lcm[mask]
Initialize DP array of size 2^len(target) with infinity, set dp[0] = 0
For each number in nums, update DP by trying all masks and transitioning to new_mask = mask | submask (use fresh DP copy per element to prevent reuse)
Return dp[(1 << len(target)) - 1] as the final answer
Verify solution against all three examples (expect 1, 2, 0) and edge cases (already-satisfied targets, single element covering multiple targets via common multiple)
